the Father, and the Son, ✠ and the Holy Spirit.
In a Pontifical Mass, the Celebrant receives the miter and, extending his hands, sings:
Blessed be the name of the Lord.
Our help is in the name of the Lord.
The Celebrant receives the pastoral staff, if he uses it, and sings:
Making the Sign of the Cross over the people three times, he adds:
the Father, ✠ and the Son, ✠ and the Holy ✠ Spirit.
